62	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
63	# RE-specific consensus construction
64	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
65	
66	def relation_key(r: dict) -> tuple:
67	    return (r["head_start"], r["head_end"], r["tail_start"], r["tail_end"], r["type"])
68	
69	
70	def consensus_construct_re(
71	    inst: dict,
72	    high_thresh: float = 0.5,
73	    medium_thresh: float = 0.25,
74	) -> list[dict]:
75	    """LP-weighted relation construction (adapted from NER consensus_construct)."""
76	    samples = inst["samples"]
77	    N = len(samples)
78	
79	    rel_counts: Counter = Counter()
80	    rel_sample_indices: dict[tuple, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
81	    rel_repr: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
82	
83	    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
84	        seen: set[tuple] = set()
85	        for r in s.get("relations", []):
86	            key = relation_key(r)
87	            if key not in seen:
88	                rel_counts[key] += 1
89	                rel_sample_indices[key].append(i)
90	                seen.add(key)
91	                if key not in rel_repr:
92	                    rel_repr[key] = r
93	
94	    sample_lps = []
95	    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
96	        lp = s.get("mean_logprob")
97	        if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
98	            lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
99	        if lp is not None:
100	            sample_lps.append(lp)
101	    instance_median_lp = statistics.median(sample_lps) if sample_lps else 0.0
102	
103	    consensus = []
104	    for key, count in rel_counts.items():
105	        freq = count / N
106	        if freq > high_thresh:
107	            consensus.append(rel_repr[key])
108	        elif freq > medium_thresh:
109	            contributing_lps = []
110	            for i in rel_sample_indices[key]:
111	                lp = samples[i].get("mean_logprob")
112	                if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
113	                    lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
114	                if lp is not None:
115	                    contributing_lps.append(lp)
116	            if contributing_lps:
117	                mean_lp = statistics.mean(contributing_lps)
118	                if mean_lp > instance_median_lp:
119	                    consensus.append(rel_repr[key])
120	
121	    return consensus
122	
123	
124	def majority_vote_re(
125	    samples: list[dict],
126	    threshold: float = 0.5,
127	) -> list[dict]:
128	    """Majority vote for relation triples at a given frequency threshold."""
129	    N = len(samples)
130	    rel_counts: Counter = Counter()
131	    rel_repr: dict[tuple, dict] = {}
132	
133	    for s in samples:
134	        seen: set[tuple] = set()
135	        for r in s.get("relations", []):
136	            key = relation_key(r)
137	            if key not in seen:
138	                rel_counts[key] += 1
139	                seen.add(key)
140	                if key not in rel_repr:
141	                    rel_repr[key] = r
142	
143	    return [rel_repr[key] for key, count in rel_counts.items() if count / N >= threshold]
144	
145

147	# Degeneracy detection (RE-specific)
148	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
149	
150	def is_degenerate_re(inst: dict) -> bool:
151	    """All samples produce identical relation sets."""
152	    key_sets: set[frozenset] = set()
153	    for s in inst["samples"]:
154	        ks = frozenset(relation_key(r) for r in s.get("relations", []))
155	        key_sets.add(ks)
156	    return len(key_sets) == 1

163	def classify_failure_mode(
164	    inst: dict,
165	    greedy_f1: float,
166	    construction_f1: float,
167	    kappa: float,
168	) -> str | None:
169	    """Classify instance into F1–F4 failure modes.
170	
171	    Returns mode string or None if no failure detected.
172	    """
173	    degenerate = is_degenerate_re(inst)
174	
175	    if degenerate:
176	        return "F1_degeneracy"
177	    if kappa < 0.3:
178	        return "F2_low_agreement"
179	    if kappa >= 0.3 and greedy_f1 < 0.3:
180	        return "F3_high_agreement_low_quality"
181	    if construction_f1 - greedy_f1 < -0.05:
182	        return "F4_lp_quality_gap"
183	    return None
184	
185	
186	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
187	# Main evaluation logic
188	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
189	
190	def evaluate_re_sc(
191	    sampled_instances: list[dict],
192	    output_dir: str,
193	    high_thresh: float = 0.5,
194	    medium_thresh: float = 0.25,
195	) -> dict:
196	    """Run full RE SC diagnostic evaluation."""
197	    N_samples = len(sampled_instances[0]["samples"]) if sampled_instances else 0
198	    theta = 2 / N_samples if N_samples > 0 else 0.25
199	
200	    if medium_thresh is None:
201	        medium_thresh = theta
202	
203	    results = {
204	        "n_instances": len(sampled_instances),
205	        "n_samples": N_samples,
206	        "high_thresh": high_thresh,
207	        "medium_thresh": medium_thresh,
208	    }
209	
210	    # --- Per-instance metrics ---
211	    greedy_f1s = []
212	    construction_f1s = []
213	    majority_f1s = []
214	    oracle_f1s = []
215	    kappas = []
216	    soft_jaccards = []
217	    degen_flags = []
218	    failure_modes: list[str | None] = []
219	
220	    for inst in sampled_instances:
221	        gold = inst["gold"]
222	        samples = inst["samples"]
223	
224	        greedy = inst.get("greedy", samples[0])
225	        g_f1 = per_instance_f1(greedy, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
226	        greedy_f1s.append(g_f1)
227	
228	        construction_rels = consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)
229	        c_pred = {"relations": construction_rels}
230	        c_f1 = per_instance_f1(c_pred, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
231	        construction_f1s.append(c_f1)
232	
233	        mv_rels = majority_vote_re(samples, threshold=0.5)
234	        mv_pred = {"relations": mv_rels}
235	        mv_f1 = per_instance_f1(mv_pred, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
236	        majority_f1s.append(mv_f1)
237	
238	        _, o_f1 = oracle_best_of_n(samples, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
239	        oracle_f1s.append(o_f1)
240	
241	        kappa = fleiss_kappa_surface(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
242	        kappas.append(kappa)
243	
244	        sj = structural_consistency_soft_jaccard(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
245	        soft_jaccards.append(sj)
246	
247	        degen = is_degenerate_re(inst)
248	        degen_flags.append(degen)
249	
250	        fm = classify_failure_mode(inst, g_f1, c_f1, kappa)
251	        failure_modes.append(fm)
252	
253	    # --- Aggregate metrics ---
254	    results["greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(greedy_f1s))
255	    results["construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(construction_f1s))
256	    results["majority_vote_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(majority_f1s))
257	    results["oracle_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(oracle_f1s))
258	    results["fleiss_kappa_mean"] = float(np.mean(kappas))
259	    results["soft_jaccard_mean"] = float(np.mean(soft_jaccards))
260	
261	    n = len(sampled_instances)
262	    n_degen = sum(degen_flags)
263	    results["degeneracy_rate"] = n_degen / n if n > 0 else 0.0
264	    results["n_degenerate"] = n_degen
265	    results["n_nondegenerate"] = n - n_degen
266	
267	    # --- Micro-averaged F1 ---
268	    greedy_preds = [inst.get("greedy", inst["samples"][0]) for inst in sampled_instances]
269	    golds = [inst["gold"] for inst in sampled_instances]
270	    results["greedy_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(greedy_preds, golds)
271	
272	    construction_preds = []
273	    for inst in sampled_instances:
274	        construction_preds.append({"relations": consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)})
275	    results["construction_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(construction_preds, golds)
276	
277	    # --- Failure mode distribution ---
278	    fm_counts: Counter = Counter()
279	    for fm in failure_modes:
280	        fm_counts[fm or "none"] += 1
281	    results["failure_modes"] = dict(fm_counts)
282	    results["failure_mode_pcts"] = {k: v / n * 100 for k, v in fm_counts.items()} if n > 0 else {}
283	
284	    # --- Non-degenerate stratification ---
285	    if n - n_degen > 0:
286	        nd_mask = [not d for d in degen_flags]
287	        nd_greedy = [f for f, m in zip(greedy_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
288	        nd_construction = [f for f, m in zip(construction_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
289	        results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_greedy))
290	        results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_construction))
291	        results["nondegen_diff"] = results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] - results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"]
292	
293	    # --- Paired bootstrap test ---
294	    results["bootstrap"] = run_bootstrap_re(greedy_f1s, construction_f1s, degen_flags)
295	
296	    # --- Per-instance data (for downstream analysis) ---
297	    per_instance = []
298	    for i, inst in enumerate(sampled_instances):
299	        per_instance.append({
300	            "id": inst["id"],
301	            "greedy_f1": greedy_f1s[i],
302	            "construction_f1": construction_f1s[i],
303	            "majority_vote_f1": majority_f1s[i],
304	            "oracle_f1": oracle_f1s[i],
305	            "fleiss_kappa": kappas[i],
306	            "soft_jaccard": soft_jaccards[i],
307	            "degenerate": degen_flags[i],
308	            "failure_mode": failure_modes[i],
309	            "n_gold_relations": len(inst["gold"].get("relations", [])),
310	        })
311	
312	    # --- Save outputs ---
313	    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
314	
315	    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_sc_results.json"), "w") as f:
316	        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
317	
318	    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_per_instance.json"), "w") as f:
319	        json.dump(per_instance, f, indent=2)
320	
321	    print_summary(results)
322	    return results
323	
324	
325	def run_bootstrap_re(
326	    greedy_f1s: list[float],
327	    construction_f1s: list[float],
328	    degen_flags: list[bool],
329	    B: int = 10000,
330	    seed: int = 42,
331	) -> dict:
332	    """Paired bootstrap test: greedy vs LP-weighted construction for RE."""
333	    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
334	    n = len(greedy_f1s)
335	
336	    greedy_arr = np.array(greedy_f1s)
337	    construction_arr = np.array(construction_f1s)
338	    diffs = construction_arr - greedy_arr
339	
340	    obs_diff = float(diffs.mean())
341	
342	    boot_diffs = np.zeros(B)
343	    for b in range(B):
344	        idx = rng.randint(0, n, n)
345	        boot_diffs[b] = diffs[idx].mean()
346	    boot_diffs.sort()
347	
348	    ci_lo = float(boot_diffs[int(0.025 * B)])
349	    ci_hi = float(boot_diffs[int(0.975 * B)])
350	    p_value = float(np.mean(boot_diffs <= 0))
351	
352	    std_diff = float(diffs.std(ddof=1))
353	    cohens_d = obs_diff / std_diff if std_diff > 0 else float("inf")
354	
355	    result = {
356	        "observed_diff": obs_diff,
357	        "ci_95": [ci_lo, ci_hi],
358	        "p_value": p_value,
359	        "cohens_d": cohens_d,
360	        "B": B,
361	        "n_positive": int(np.sum(diffs > 0)),
362	        "n_negative": int(np.sum(diffs < 0)),
363	        "n_tied": int(np.sum(diffs == 0)),
364	    }
365	
366	    degen_arr = np.array(degen_flags, dtype=bool)
367	    nd_mask = ~degen_arr
368	    if nd_mask.sum() > 0:
369	        nd_diffs = diffs[nd_mask]
370	        nd_n = nd_diffs.shape[0]
371	        nd_boot = np.zeros(B)
372	        for b in range(B):
373	            idx = rng.randint(0, nd_n, nd_n)
374	            nd_boot[b] = nd_diffs[idx].mean()
375	        nd_boot.sort()
376	        result["nondegen_observed_diff"] = float(nd_diffs.mean())
377	        result["nondegen_ci_95"] = [float(nd_boot[int(0.025 * B)]), float(nd_boot[int(0.975 * B)])]
378	        result["nondegen_p_value"] = float(np.mean(nd_boot <= 0))
379	
380	    return result
381	
382	
383	def print_summary(results: dict):
384	    """Print human-readable summary."""
385	    n = results["n_instances"]
386	    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
387	    print(f"  RE Self-Consistency Diagnostic — {n} instances")
388	    print(f"{'='*60}")
389	    print(f"Greedy F1 (mean):         {results['greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
390	    print(f"Construction F1 (mean):   {results['construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
391	    print(f"Majority Vote F1 (mean):  {results['majority_vote_f1_mean']:.4f}")
392	    print(f"Oracle F1 (mean):         {results['oracle_f1_mean']:.4f}")
393	    print(f"Fleiss' κ (mean):         {results['fleiss_kappa_mean']:.4f}")
394	    print(f"Soft Jaccard (mean):      {results['soft_jaccard_mean']:.4f}")
395	    print(f"Degeneracy rate:          {results['degeneracy_rate']:.2%} ({results['n_degenerate']}/{n})")
396	
397	    micro = results.get("greedy_micro_f1", {})
398	    print(f"\nMicro-avg greedy:         P={micro.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro.get('f1',0):.4f}")
399	    micro_c = results.get("construction_micro_f1", {})
400	    print(f"Micro-avg construction:   P={micro_c.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro_c.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro_c.get('f1',0):.4f}")
401	
402	    if "nondegen_diff" in results:
403	        print(f"\nNon-degen greedy F1:      {results['nondegen_greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
404	        print(f"Non-degen construction:   {results['nondegen_construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
405	        print(f"Non-degen diff:           {results['nondegen_diff']:+.4f}")
406	
407	    print(f"\nFailure mode distribution:")
408	    for mode, pct in sorted(results.get("failure_mode_pcts", {}).items()):
409	        print(f"  {mode}: {pct:.1f}%")
410	
411	    boot = results.get("bootstrap", {})
412	    if boot:
413	        print(f"\nBootstrap (B={boot.get('B', 10000)}):")
414	        print(f"  Diff: {boot.get('observed_diff', 0):+.4f}")
415	        ci = boot.get("ci_95", [0, 0])
416	        print(f"  95% CI: [{ci[0]:+.4f}, {ci[1]:+.4f}]")
417	        print(f"  p-value: {boot.get('p_value', 1):.4f}")
418	
419	
420	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
421	# Main
422	# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
423

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Relation Extraction Self-Consistency diagnostic experiment.

Runs the full SC pipeline on SciERC RE data:
1. Load prepared RE instances (from prepare_re_data.py)
2. Sample N completions per instance via VLLMSampler + XGrammar
3. Compute RE F1 (greedy, majority vote, LP-weighted construction, oracle)
4. Compute SC diagnostic signals (degeneracy, Fleiss' κ, soft Jaccard)
5. Classify failure modes F1–F4
6. Run paired bootstrap test (construction vs greedy)

Usage:
    # Full pipeline (sampling + evaluation)
    python run_re_sc.py \
        --model-path /root/autodl-tmp/models/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct \
        --data /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/data/re_test_instances.jsonl \
        --output-dir /root/autodl-tmp/struct_self_consist_ie/output/re_sc

    # Evaluation only (skip sampling, load existing samples)
    python run_re_sc.py \
        --samples /path/to/re_samples.jsonl \
        --output-dir /path/to/output \
        --eval-only
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import statistics
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import numpy as np

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))

from sampling import (
    VLLMSampler,
    SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT,
    run_sampling_pipeline,
    load_sampled_results,
    save_sampled_results,
)
from evaluation import (
    per_instance_f1,
    relation_strict_match,
    compute_re_f1,
    _prf,
)
from consistency import (
    fleiss_kappa_surface,
    structural_consistency_soft_jaccard,
    oracle_best_of_n,
    compute_all_consistency_scores,
)
from data_utils import load_uie_jsonl


SUBTASK = "re"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# RE-specific consensus construction
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def relation_key(r: dict) -> tuple:
    return (r["head_start"], r["head_end"], r["tail_start"], r["tail_end"], r["type"])


def consensus_construct_re(
    inst: dict,
    high_thresh: float = 0.5,
    medium_thresh: float = 0.25,
) -> list[dict]:
    """LP-weighted relation construction (adapted from NER consensus_construct)."""
    samples = inst["samples"]
    N = len(samples)

    rel_counts: Counter = Counter()
    rel_sample_indices: dict[tuple, list[int]] = defaultdict(list)
    rel_repr: dict[tuple, dict] = {}

    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
        seen: set[tuple] = set()
        for r in s.get("relations", []):
            key = relation_key(r)
            if key not in seen:
                rel_counts[key] += 1
                rel_sample_indices[key].append(i)
                seen.add(key)
                if key not in rel_repr:
                    rel_repr[key] = r

    sample_lps = []
    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
        lp = s.get("mean_logprob")
        if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
            lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
        if lp is not None:
            sample_lps.append(lp)
    instance_median_lp = statistics.median(sample_lps) if sample_lps else 0.0

    consensus = []
    for key, count in rel_counts.items():
        freq = count / N
        if freq > high_thresh:
            consensus.append(rel_repr[key])
        elif freq > medium_thresh:
            contributing_lps = []
            for i in rel_sample_indices[key]:
                lp = samples[i].get("mean_logprob")
                if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
                    lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
                if lp is not None:
                    contributing_lps.append(lp)
            if contributing_lps:
                mean_lp = statistics.mean(contributing_lps)
                if mean_lp > instance_median_lp:
                    consensus.append(rel_repr[key])

    return consensus


def majority_vote_re(
    samples: list[dict],
    threshold: float = 0.5,
) -> list[dict]:
    """Majority vote for relation triples at a given frequency threshold."""
    N = len(samples)
    rel_counts: Counter = Counter()
    rel_repr: dict[tuple, dict] = {}

    for s in samples:
        seen: set[tuple] = set()
        for r in s.get("relations", []):
            key = relation_key(r)
            if key not in seen:
                rel_counts[key] += 1
                seen.add(key)
                if key not in rel_repr:
                    rel_repr[key] = r

    return [rel_repr[key] for key, count in rel_counts.items() if count / N >= threshold]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Degeneracy detection (RE-specific)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def is_degenerate_re(inst: dict) -> bool:
    """All samples produce identical relation sets."""
    key_sets: set[frozenset] = set()
    for s in inst["samples"]:
        ks = frozenset(relation_key(r) for r in s.get("relations", []))
        key_sets.add(ks)
    return len(key_sets) == 1


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Failure mode classification
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def classify_failure_mode(
    inst: dict,
    greedy_f1: float,
    construction_f1: float,
    kappa: float,
) -> str | None:
    """Classify instance into F1–F4 failure modes.

    Returns mode string or None if no failure detected.
    """
    degenerate = is_degenerate_re(inst)

    if degenerate:
        return "F1_degeneracy"
    if kappa < 0.3:
        return "F2_low_agreement"
    if kappa >= 0.3 and greedy_f1 < 0.3:
        return "F3_high_agreement_low_quality"
    if construction_f1 - greedy_f1 < -0.05:
        return "F4_lp_quality_gap"
    return None


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main evaluation logic
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def evaluate_re_sc(
    sampled_instances: list[dict],
    output_dir: str,
    high_thresh: float = 0.5,
    medium_thresh: float = 0.25,
) -> dict:
    """Run full RE SC diagnostic evaluation."""
    N_samples = len(sampled_instances[0]["samples"]) if sampled_instances else 0
    theta = 2 / N_samples if N_samples > 0 else 0.25

    if medium_thresh is None:
        medium_thresh = theta

    results = {
        "n_instances": len(sampled_instances),
        "n_samples": N_samples,
        "high_thresh": high_thresh,
        "medium_thresh": medium_thresh,
    }

    # --- Per-instance metrics ---
    greedy_f1s = []
    construction_f1s = []
    majority_f1s = []
    oracle_f1s = []
    kappas = []
    soft_jaccards = []
    degen_flags = []
    failure_modes: list[str | None] = []

    for inst in sampled_instances:
        gold = inst["gold"]
        samples = inst["samples"]

        greedy = inst.get("greedy", samples[0])
        g_f1 = per_instance_f1(greedy, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        greedy_f1s.append(g_f1)

        construction_rels = consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)
        c_pred = {"relations": construction_rels}
        c_f1 = per_instance_f1(c_pred, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        construction_f1s.append(c_f1)

        mv_rels = majority_vote_re(samples, threshold=0.5)
        mv_pred = {"relations": mv_rels}
        mv_f1 = per_instance_f1(mv_pred, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        majority_f1s.append(mv_f1)

        _, o_f1 = oracle_best_of_n(samples, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        oracle_f1s.append(o_f1)

        kappa = fleiss_kappa_surface(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
        kappas.append(kappa)

        sj = structural_consistency_soft_jaccard(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
        soft_jaccards.append(sj)

        degen = is_degenerate_re(inst)
        degen_flags.append(degen)

        fm = classify_failure_mode(inst, g_f1, c_f1, kappa)
        failure_modes.append(fm)

    # --- Aggregate metrics ---
    results["greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(greedy_f1s))
    results["construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(construction_f1s))
    results["majority_vote_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(majority_f1s))
    results["oracle_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(oracle_f1s))
    results["fleiss_kappa_mean"] = float(np.mean(kappas))
    results["soft_jaccard_mean"] = float(np.mean(soft_jaccards))

    n = len(sampled_instances)
    n_degen = sum(degen_flags)
    results["degeneracy_rate"] = n_degen / n if n > 0 else 0.0
    results["n_degenerate"] = n_degen
    results["n_nondegenerate"] = n - n_degen

    # --- Micro-averaged F1 ---
    greedy_preds = [inst.get("greedy", inst["samples"][0]) for inst in sampled_instances]
    golds = [inst["gold"] for inst in sampled_instances]
    results["greedy_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(greedy_preds, golds)

    construction_preds = []
    for inst in sampled_instances:
        construction_preds.append({"relations": consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)})
    results["construction_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(construction_preds, golds)

    # --- Failure mode distribution ---
    fm_counts: Counter = Counter()
    for fm in failure_modes:
        fm_counts[fm or "none"] += 1
    results["failure_modes"] = dict(fm_counts)
    results["failure_mode_pcts"] = {k: v / n * 100 for k, v in fm_counts.items()} if n > 0 else {}

    # --- Non-degenerate stratification ---
    if n - n_degen > 0:
        nd_mask = [not d for d in degen_flags]
        nd_greedy = [f for f, m in zip(greedy_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
        nd_construction = [f for f, m in zip(construction_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
        results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_greedy))
        results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_construction))
        results["nondegen_diff"] = results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] - results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"]

    # --- Paired bootstrap test ---
    results["bootstrap"] = run_bootstrap_re(greedy_f1s, construction_f1s, degen_flags)

    # --- Per-instance data (for downstream analysis) ---
    per_instance = []
    for i, inst in enumerate(sampled_instances):
        per_instance.append({
            "id": inst["id"],
            "greedy_f1": greedy_f1s[i],
            "construction_f1": construction_f1s[i],
            "majority_vote_f1": majority_f1s[i],
            "oracle_f1": oracle_f1s[i],
            "fleiss_kappa": kappas[i],
            "soft_jaccard": soft_jaccards[i],
            "degenerate": degen_flags[i],
            "failure_mode": failure_modes[i],
            "n_gold_relations": len(inst["gold"].get("relations", [])),
        })

    # --- Save outputs ---
    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)

    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_sc_results.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_per_instance.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(per_instance, f, indent=2)

    print_summary(results)
    return results


def run_bootstrap_re(
    greedy_f1s: list[float],
    construction_f1s: list[float],
    degen_flags: list[bool],
    B: int = 10000,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> dict:
    """Paired bootstrap test: greedy vs LP-weighted construction for RE."""
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(greedy_f1s)

    greedy_arr = np.array(greedy_f1s)
    construction_arr = np.array(construction_f1s)
    diffs = construction_arr - greedy_arr

    obs_diff = float(diffs.mean())

    boot_diffs = np.zeros(B)
    for b in range(B):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, n)
        boot_diffs[b] = diffs[idx].mean()
    boot_diffs.sort()

    ci_lo = float(boot_diffs[int(0.025 * B)])
    ci_hi = float(boot_diffs[int(0.975 * B)])
    p_value = float(np.mean(boot_diffs <= 0))

    std_diff = float(diffs.std(ddof=1))
    cohens_d = obs_diff / std_diff if std_diff > 0 else float("inf")

    result = {
        "observed_diff": obs_diff,
        "ci_95": [ci_lo, ci_hi],
        "p_value": p_value,
        "cohens_d": cohens_d,
        "B": B,
        "n_positive": int(np.sum(diffs > 0)),
        "n_negative": int(np.sum(diffs < 0)),
        "n_tied": int(np.sum(diffs == 0)),
    }

    degen_arr = np.array(degen_flags, dtype=bool)
    nd_mask = ~degen_arr
    if nd_mask.sum() > 0:
        nd_diffs = diffs[nd_mask]
        nd_n = nd_diffs.shape[0]
        nd_boot = np.zeros(B)
        for b in range(B):
            idx = rng.randint(0, nd_n, nd_n)
            nd_boot[b] = nd_diffs[idx].mean()
        nd_boot.sort()
        result["nondegen_observed_diff"] = float(nd_diffs.mean())
        result["nondegen_ci_95"] = [float(nd_boot[int(0.025 * B)]), float(nd_boot[int(0.975 * B)])]
        result["nondegen_p_value"] = float(np.mean(nd_boot <= 0))

    return result


def print_summary(results: dict):
    """Print human-readable summary."""
    n = results["n_instances"]
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  RE Self-Consistency Diagnostic — {n} instances")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Greedy F1 (mean):         {results['greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Construction F1 (mean):   {results['construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Majority Vote F1 (mean):  {results['majority_vote_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Oracle F1 (mean):         {results['oracle_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Fleiss' κ (mean):         {results['fleiss_kappa_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Soft Jaccard (mean):      {results['soft_jaccard_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Degeneracy rate:          {results['degeneracy_rate']:.2%} ({results['n_degenerate']}/{n})")

    micro = results.get("greedy_micro_f1", {})
    print(f"\nMicro-avg greedy:         P={micro.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro.get('f1',0):.4f}")
    micro_c = results.get("construction_micro_f1", {})
    print(f"Micro-avg construction:   P={micro_c.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro_c.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro_c.get('f1',0):.4f}")

    if "nondegen_diff" in results:
        print(f"\nNon-degen greedy F1:      {results['nondegen_greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
        print(f"Non-degen construction:   {results['nondegen_construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
        print(f"Non-degen diff:           {results['nondegen_diff']:+.4f}")

    print(f"\nFailure mode distribution:")
    for mode, pct in sorted(results.get("failure_mode_pcts", {}).items()):
        print(f"  {mode}: {pct:.1f}%")

    boot = results.get("bootstrap", {})
    if boot:
        print(f"\nBootstrap (B={boot.get('B', 10000)}):")
        print(f"  Diff: {boot.get('observed_diff', 0):+.4f}")
        ci = boot.get("ci_95", [0, 0])
        print(f"  95% CI: [{ci[0]:+.4f}, {ci[1]:+.4f}]")
        print(f"  p-value: {boot.get('p_value', 1):.4f}")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="RE Self-Consistency Diagnostic")
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=None,
                        help="Path to Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct model")
    parser.add_argument("--data", default=None,
                        help="Path to prepared RE instances JSONL (from prepare_re_data.py)")
    parser.add_argument("--samples", default=None,
                        help="Path to existing sampled results JSONL (skip sampling)")
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True,
                        help="Output directory")
    parser.add_argument("--eval-only", action="store_true",
                        help="Skip sampling, load --samples directly")
    parser.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=1024)
    parser.add_argument("--tensor-parallel", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--use-train-format", action="store_true",
                        help="Use train-aligned prompt template (joint NER+RE)")
    parser.add_argument("--high-thresh", type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument("--medium-thresh", type=float, default=None,
                        help="LP threshold (default: 2/N)")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.eval_only:
        if not args.samples:
            parser.error("--samples required when --eval-only is set")
        sampled = load_sampled_results(args.samples)
    else:
        if not args.model_path or not args.data:
            parser.error("--model-path and --data required for sampling")

        instances = load_uie_jsonl(args.data)
        print(f"Loaded {len(instances)} RE instances")

        sampler = VLLMSampler(
            model_path=args.model_path,
            tensor_parallel_size=args.tensor_parallel,
            max_model_len=4096,
            gpu_memory_utilization=0.90,
        )

        sampled = run_sampling_pipeline(
            sampler=sampler,
            instances=instances,
            n_samples=args.n_samples,
            temperature=args.temperature,
            max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
            subtask="re" if not args.use_train_format else "full",
            schema_hint=SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT,
            use_grammar=True,
            use_chat_template=True,
            use_train_format=args.use_train_format,
            output_path=os.path.join(args.output_dir, "re_samples.jsonl"),
            realign=True,
            collect_logprobs=True,
        )
        print(f"Sampled {len(sampled)} instances × {args.n_samples} samples")

    evaluate_re_sc(
        sampled,
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        high_thresh=args.high_thresh,
        medium_thresh=args.medium_thresh,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Prepare SciERC data for Relation Extraction SC experiments.

Loads SciERC test split, filters to instances with ≥1 gold relation,
builds few-shot RE prompts, and outputs JSONL for the sampling pipeline.

Usage:
    python prepare_re_data.py \
        --scierc-dir /path/to/scierc \
        --output /path/to/re_test_instances.jsonl \
        --few-shot-k 3
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import random
import sys

_project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))
sys.path.insert(0, _project_root)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(_project_root, "code"))

from data_utils import load_scierc, Instance
from sampling import SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT


SCHEMA_HINT = SCIERC_SCHEMA_HINT

RE_FEWSHOT_INSTRUCTION = (
    "Extract all relations (head entity, relation type, tail entity) from the given text. "
    "Output a JSON object with fields: entities, relations, events.\n\n"
    f"{SCHEMA_HINT}\n\n"
    "Output format: "
    '{"entities": [], '
    '"relations": [{"head": "...", "tail": "...", "type": "...", '
    '"head_start": <int>, "head_end": <int>, "tail_start": <int>, "tail_end": <int>}], '
    '"events": []}\n'
)


def instance_to_demo(inst: Instance) -> str:
    """Format a gold instance as a few-shot demonstration."""
    text = inst["text"]
    gold_rels = inst.get("relations", [])
    gold_json = json.dumps(
        {"entities": [], "relations": gold_rels, "events": []},
        ensure_ascii=False,
    )
    return f"Text: {text}\nOutput: {gold_json}"


def build_fewshot_prompt(
    inst: Instance,
    demos: list[Instance],
) -> str:
    """Build a few-shot RE prompt for a test instance."""
    parts = [RE_FEWSHOT_INSTRUCTION]
    for i, demo in enumerate(demos):
        parts.append(f"### Example {i + 1}\n{instance_to_demo(demo)}")
    parts.append(f"### Now extract:\nText: {inst['text']}\nOutput:")
    return "\n\n".join(parts)


def build_zeroshot_prompt(inst: Instance) -> str:
    """Build a zero-shot RE prompt for a test instance."""
    return (
        f"{RE_FEWSHOT_INSTRUCTION}\n"
        f"Text: {inst['text']}\nOutput:"
    )


def select_demos(
    train_instances: list[Instance],
    k: int,
    seed: int = 42,
) -> list[Instance]:
    """Select k diverse few-shot demonstrations from training set.

    Picks instances that have relations AND cover diverse relation types.
    """
    rel_instances = [inst for inst in train_instances if inst.get("relations")]
    if not rel_instances:
        return []

    rng = random.Random(seed)

    seen_types: set[str] = set()
    selected: list[Instance] = []

    rng.shuffle(rel_instances)
    for inst in rel_instances:
        rel_types = {r["type"] for r in inst["relations"]}
        new_types = rel_types - seen_types
        if new_types:
            selected.append(inst)
            seen_types |= rel_types
            if len(selected) >= k:
                break

    while len(selected) < k and len(selected) < len(rel_instances):
        candidate = rng.choice(rel_instances)
        if candidate not in selected:
            selected.append(candidate)

    return selected[:k]


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Prepare SciERC RE data for SC experiments")
    parser.add_argument("--scierc-dir", required=True, help="Path to SciERC data directory")
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True, help="Output JSONL path for test instances")
    parser.add_argument("--demo-output", default=None, help="Output path for few-shot demos JSON")
    parser.add_argument("--few-shot-k", type=int, default=3, help="Number of few-shot examples")
    parser.add_argument("--prompt-mode", choices=["zeroshot", "fewshot", "train_aligned"],
                        default="fewshot", help="Prompt construction mode")
    parser.add_argument("--min-relations", type=int, default=1,
                        help="Minimum gold relations to include instance")
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    parser.add_argument("--stats", action="store_true", help="Print dataset statistics")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    splits = load_scierc(args.scierc_dir)
    train_all = splits["train"]
    test_all = splits["test"]

    test_re = [inst for inst in test_all if len(inst.get("relations", [])) >= args.min_relations]

    if args.stats:
        for split_name, insts in [("train", train_all), ("test", test_all), ("test_re_filtered", test_re)]:
            n_rels = sum(len(inst.get("relations", [])) for inst in insts)
            n_with_rel = sum(1 for inst in insts if inst.get("relations"))
            rel_types = set()
            for inst in insts:
                for r in inst.get("relations", []):
                    rel_types.add(r["type"])
            print(f"{split_name}: {len(insts)} instances, {n_with_rel} with relations, "
                  f"{n_rels} total relations, types: {sorted(rel_types)}")

    demos = select_demos(train_all, args.few_shot_k, seed=args.seed)

    output_instances = []
    for inst in test_re:
        if args.prompt_mode == "fewshot":
            prompt = build_fewshot_prompt(inst, demos)
        elif args.prompt_mode == "zeroshot":
            prompt = build_zeroshot_prompt(inst)
        else:
            prompt = None

        record = {
            "id": inst["id"],
            "text": inst["text"],
            "entities": inst.get("entities", []),
            "relations": inst.get("relations", []),
            "events": [],
        }
        if prompt is not None:
            record["prompt"] = prompt

        output_instances.append(record)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.output) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for inst in output_instances:
            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    print(f"Wrote {len(output_instances)} RE instances to {args.output}")
    print(f"  Relation types in test set: {sorted({r['type'] for inst in output_instances for r in inst['relations']})}")
    print(f"  Total gold relations: {sum(len(inst['relations']) for inst in output_instances)}")

    if args.demo_output and demos:
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.demo_output) or ".", exist_ok=True)
        with open(args.demo_output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump([dict(d) for d in demos], f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        print(f"Wrote {len(demos)} few-shot demos to {args.demo_output}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    schema_line = f"Schema: {schema_hint}\n" if schema_hint else ""

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Convert FewRel val set to UIE JSONL format for RE SC experiments."""

import json
import os
import random
import sys

_project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))
sys.path.insert(0, _project_root)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(_project_root, "code"))

FEWREL_VAL_RELATION_NAMES = {
    "P155": "follows",
    "P177": "crosses",
    "P206": "located in or next to body of water",
    "P2094": "competition class",
    "P25": "mother",
    "P26": "spouse",
    "P361": "part of",
    "P364": "original language of film or TV show",
    "P40": "child",
    "P410": "military rank",
    "P412": "voice type",
    "P413": "position played on team / speciality",
    "P463": "member of",
    "P59": "constellation",
    "P641": "sport",
    "P921": "main subject",
}


def token_offsets(tokens):
    offsets = []
    pos = 0
    for tok in tokens:
        offsets.append((pos, pos + len(tok)))
        pos += len(tok) + 1
    return offsets


def convert_instance(inst, relation_name, instance_id):
    tokens = inst["tokens"]
    text = " ".join(tokens)
    offsets = token_offsets(tokens)

    h_name, _, h_token_idxs = inst["h"]
    t_name, _, t_token_idxs = inst["t"]
    h_indices = h_token_idxs[0]
    t_indices = t_token_idxs[0]

    if not h_indices or not t_indices:
        return None
    if max(h_indices) >= len(tokens) or max(t_indices) >= len(tokens):
        return None

    h_start_char = offsets[h_indices[0]][0]
    h_end_char = offsets[h_indices[-1]][1]
    t_start_char = offsets[t_indices[0]][0]
    t_end_char = offsets[t_indices[-1]][1]

    h_text = text[h_start_char:h_end_char]
    t_text = text[t_start_char:t_end_char]

    entities = [
        {"text": h_text, "type": "ENTITY", "start": h_start_char, "end": h_end_char},
        {"text": t_text, "type": "ENTITY", "start": t_start_char, "end": t_end_char},
    ]
    relations = [
        {
            "head": h_text, "tail": t_text, "type": relation_name,
            "head_start": h_start_char, "head_end": h_end_char,
            "tail_start": t_start_char, "tail_end": t_end_char,
        }
    ]

    return {
        "id": instance_id,
        "text": text,
        "entities": entities,
        "relations": relations,
        "events": [],
    }


def main():
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--fewrel-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--n-instances", type=int, default=256)
    parser.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=42)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    with open(os.path.join(args.fewrel_dir, "val_wiki.json")) as f:
        val_data = json.load(f)

    rng = random.Random(args.seed)
    n_per_type = max(1, args.n_instances // len(val_data))
    remainder = args.n_instances - n_per_type * len(val_data)

    all_instances = []
    for pid, instances in sorted(val_data.items()):
        rel_name = FEWREL_VAL_RELATION_NAMES.get(pid, pid)
        converted = []
        for i, inst in enumerate(instances):
            result = convert_instance(inst, rel_name, f"fewrel_{pid}_{i:04d}")
            if result is not None:
                converted.append(result)
        rng.shuffle(converted)
        selected = converted[:n_per_type]
        all_instances.extend(selected)
        if remainder > 0 and len(converted) > n_per_type:
            extra = converted[n_per_type:n_per_type + 1]
            all_instances.extend(extra)
            remainder -= len(extra)

    rng.shuffle(all_instances)
    all_instances = all_instances[:args.n_instances]

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(args.output) or ".", exist_ok=True)
    with open(args.output, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        for inst in all_instances:
            f.write(json.dumps(inst, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    rel_types = set()
    for inst in all_instances:
        for r in inst["relations"]:
            rel_types.add(r["type"])
    print(f"Wrote {len(all_instances)} instances to {args.output}")
    print(f"Relation types ({len(rel_types)}): {sorted(rel_types)}")
    print(f"Total gold relations: {sum(len(inst['relations']) for inst in all_instances)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""FewRel RE Self-Consistency diagnostic experiment.

Adapted from SciERC run_re_sc.py for FewRel dataset.
"""

import argparse
import json
import os
import statistics
import sys
from collections import Counter, defaultdict

import numpy as np

_project_root = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "../.."))
sys.path.insert(0, _project_root)
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(_project_root, "code"))

from sampling import (
    VLLMSampler,
    run_sampling_pipeline,
    load_sampled_results,
    save_sampled_results,
)
from evaluation import (
    per_instance_f1,
    relation_strict_match,
    compute_re_f1,
    _prf,
)
from consistency import (
    fleiss_kappa_surface,
    structural_consistency_soft_jaccard,
    oracle_best_of_n,
    compute_all_consistency_scores,
)
from data_utils import load_uie_jsonl

SUBTASK = "re"

FEWREL_SCHEMA_HINT = (
    "Entity types: ENTITY\n"
    "Relation types: follows, crosses, located in or next to body of water, "
    "competition class, mother, spouse, part of, "
    "original language of film or TV show, child, military rank, "
    "voice type, position played on team / speciality, "
    "member of, constellation, sport, main subject"
)


def relation_key(r: dict) -> tuple:
    return (r["head_start"], r["head_end"], r["tail_start"], r["tail_end"], r["type"])


def consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh=0.5, medium_thresh=0.25):
    samples = inst["samples"]
    N = len(samples)
    rel_counts = Counter()
    rel_sample_indices = defaultdict(list)
    rel_repr = {}

    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
        seen = set()
        for r in s.get("relations", []):
            key = relation_key(r)
            if key not in seen:
                rel_counts[key] += 1
                rel_sample_indices[key].append(i)
                seen.add(key)
                if key not in rel_repr:
                    rel_repr[key] = r

    sample_lps = []
    for i, s in enumerate(samples):
        lp = s.get("mean_logprob")
        if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
            lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
        if lp is not None:
            sample_lps.append(lp)
    instance_median_lp = statistics.median(sample_lps) if sample_lps else 0.0

    consensus = []
    for key, count in rel_counts.items():
        freq = count / N
        if freq > high_thresh:
            consensus.append(rel_repr[key])
        elif freq > medium_thresh:
            contributing_lps = []
            for i in rel_sample_indices[key]:
                lp = samples[i].get("mean_logprob")
                if lp is None and "logprobs" in inst and i < len(inst["logprobs"]):
                    lp = inst["logprobs"][i]
                if lp is not None:
                    contributing_lps.append(lp)
            if contributing_lps:
                mean_lp = statistics.mean(contributing_lps)
                if mean_lp > instance_median_lp:
                    consensus.append(rel_repr[key])

    return consensus


def majority_vote_re(samples, threshold=0.5):
    N = len(samples)
    rel_counts = Counter()
    rel_repr = {}
    for s in samples:
        seen = set()
        for r in s.get("relations", []):
            key = relation_key(r)
            if key not in seen:
                rel_counts[key] += 1
                seen.add(key)
                if key not in rel_repr:
                    rel_repr[key] = r
    return [rel_repr[key] for key, count in rel_counts.items() if count / N >= threshold]


def is_degenerate_re(inst):
    key_sets = set()
    for s in inst["samples"]:
        ks = frozenset(relation_key(r) for r in s.get("relations", []))
        key_sets.add(ks)
    return len(key_sets) == 1


def classify_failure_mode(inst, greedy_f1, construction_f1, kappa):
    degenerate = is_degenerate_re(inst)
    if degenerate:
        return "F1_degeneracy"
    if kappa < 0.3:
        return "F2_low_agreement"
    if kappa >= 0.3 and greedy_f1 < 0.3:
        return "F3_high_agreement_low_quality"
    if construction_f1 - greedy_f1 < -0.05:
        return "F4_lp_quality_gap"
    return None


def evaluate_re_sc(sampled_instances, output_dir, high_thresh=0.5, medium_thresh=0.25):
    N_samples = len(sampled_instances[0]["samples"]) if sampled_instances else 0
    theta = 2 / N_samples if N_samples > 0 else 0.25
    if medium_thresh is None:
        medium_thresh = theta

    results = {
        "n_instances": len(sampled_instances),
        "n_samples": N_samples,
        "high_thresh": high_thresh,
        "medium_thresh": medium_thresh,
        "dataset": "fewrel",
    }

    greedy_f1s, construction_f1s, majority_f1s, oracle_f1s = [], [], [], []
    kappas, soft_jaccards, degen_flags = [], [], []
    failure_modes = []

    for inst in sampled_instances:
        gold = inst["gold"]
        samples = inst["samples"]
        greedy = inst.get("greedy", samples[0])

        g_f1 = per_instance_f1(greedy, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        greedy_f1s.append(g_f1)

        c_rels = consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)
        c_f1 = per_instance_f1({"relations": c_rels}, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        construction_f1s.append(c_f1)

        mv_rels = majority_vote_re(samples, threshold=0.5)
        mv_f1 = per_instance_f1({"relations": mv_rels}, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        majority_f1s.append(mv_f1)

        _, o_f1 = oracle_best_of_n(samples, gold, subtask=SUBTASK)
        oracle_f1s.append(o_f1)

        kappa = fleiss_kappa_surface(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
        kappas.append(kappa)

        sj = structural_consistency_soft_jaccard(samples, subtask=SUBTASK)
        soft_jaccards.append(sj)

        degen = is_degenerate_re(inst)
        degen_flags.append(degen)

        fm = classify_failure_mode(inst, g_f1, c_f1, kappa)
        failure_modes.append(fm)

    n = len(sampled_instances)
    results["greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(greedy_f1s))
    results["construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(construction_f1s))
    results["majority_vote_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(majority_f1s))
    results["oracle_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(oracle_f1s))
    results["fleiss_kappa_mean"] = float(np.mean(kappas))
    results["soft_jaccard_mean"] = float(np.mean(soft_jaccards))

    n_degen = sum(degen_flags)
    results["degeneracy_rate"] = n_degen / n if n > 0 else 0.0
    results["n_degenerate"] = n_degen
    results["n_nondegenerate"] = n - n_degen

    greedy_preds = [inst.get("greedy", inst["samples"][0]) for inst in sampled_instances]
    golds = [inst["gold"] for inst in sampled_instances]
    results["greedy_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(greedy_preds, golds)

    construction_preds = []
    for inst in sampled_instances:
        construction_preds.append({"relations": consensus_construct_re(inst, high_thresh, medium_thresh)})
    results["construction_micro_f1"] = compute_re_f1(construction_preds, golds)

    fm_counts = Counter()
    for fm in failure_modes:
        fm_counts[fm or "none"] += 1
    results["failure_modes"] = dict(fm_counts)
    results["failure_mode_pcts"] = {k: v / n * 100 for k, v in fm_counts.items()} if n > 0 else {}

    if n - n_degen > 0:
        nd_mask = [not d for d in degen_flags]
        nd_greedy = [f for f, m in zip(greedy_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
        nd_construction = [f for f, m in zip(construction_f1s, nd_mask) if m]
        results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_greedy))
        results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] = float(np.mean(nd_construction))
        results["nondegen_diff"] = results["nondegen_construction_f1_mean"] - results["nondegen_greedy_f1_mean"]

    results["bootstrap"] = run_bootstrap_re(greedy_f1s, construction_f1s, degen_flags)

    per_instance = []
    for i, inst in enumerate(sampled_instances):
        per_instance.append({
            "id": inst["id"],
            "greedy_f1": greedy_f1s[i],
            "construction_f1": construction_f1s[i],
            "majority_vote_f1": majority_f1s[i],
            "oracle_f1": oracle_f1s[i],
            "fleiss_kappa": kappas[i],
            "soft_jaccard": soft_jaccards[i],
            "degenerate": degen_flags[i],
            "failure_mode": failure_modes[i],
            "n_gold_relations": len(inst["gold"].get("relations", [])),
        })

    os.makedirs(output_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_sc_results.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(results, f, indent=2)
    with open(os.path.join(output_dir, "re_per_instance.json"), "w") as f:
        json.dump(per_instance, f, indent=2)

    print_summary(results)
    return results


def run_bootstrap_re(greedy_f1s, construction_f1s, degen_flags, B=10000, seed=42):
    rng = np.random.RandomState(seed)
    n = len(greedy_f1s)
    greedy_arr = np.array(greedy_f1s)
    construction_arr = np.array(construction_f1s)
    diffs = construction_arr - greedy_arr
    obs_diff = float(diffs.mean())

    boot_diffs = np.zeros(B)
    for b in range(B):
        idx = rng.randint(0, n, n)
        boot_diffs[b] = diffs[idx].mean()
    boot_diffs.sort()

    ci_lo = float(boot_diffs[int(0.025 * B)])
    ci_hi = float(boot_diffs[int(0.975 * B)])
    p_value = float(np.mean(boot_diffs <= 0))

    std_diff = float(diffs.std(ddof=1))
    cohens_d = obs_diff / std_diff if std_diff > 0 else float("inf")

    result = {
        "observed_diff": obs_diff,
        "ci_95": [ci_lo, ci_hi],
        "p_value": p_value,
        "cohens_d": cohens_d,
        "B": B,
        "n_positive": int(np.sum(diffs > 0)),
        "n_negative": int(np.sum(diffs < 0)),
        "n_tied": int(np.sum(diffs == 0)),
    }

    degen_arr = np.array(degen_flags, dtype=bool)
    nd_mask = ~degen_arr
    if nd_mask.sum() > 0:
        nd_diffs = diffs[nd_mask]
        nd_n = nd_diffs.shape[0]
        nd_boot = np.zeros(B)
        for b in range(B):
            idx = rng.randint(0, nd_n, nd_n)
            nd_boot[b] = nd_diffs[idx].mean()
        nd_boot.sort()
        result["nondegen_observed_diff"] = float(nd_diffs.mean())
        result["nondegen_ci_95"] = [float(nd_boot[int(0.025 * B)]), float(nd_boot[int(0.975 * B)])]
        result["nondegen_p_value"] = float(np.mean(nd_boot <= 0))

    return result


def print_summary(results):
    n = results["n_instances"]
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"  FewRel RE Self-Consistency Diagnostic — {n} instances")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    print(f"Greedy F1 (mean):         {results['greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Construction F1 (mean):   {results['construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Majority Vote F1 (mean):  {results['majority_vote_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Oracle F1 (mean):         {results['oracle_f1_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Fleiss' kappa (mean):     {results['fleiss_kappa_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Soft Jaccard (mean):      {results['soft_jaccard_mean']:.4f}")
    print(f"Degeneracy rate:          {results['degeneracy_rate']:.2%} ({results['n_degenerate']}/{n})")

    micro = results.get("greedy_micro_f1", {})
    print(f"\nMicro-avg greedy:         P={micro.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro.get('f1',0):.4f}")
    micro_c = results.get("construction_micro_f1", {})
    print(f"Micro-avg construction:   P={micro_c.get('precision',0):.4f} R={micro_c.get('recall',0):.4f} F1={micro_c.get('f1',0):.4f}")

    if "nondegen_diff" in results:
        print(f"\nNon-degen greedy F1:      {results['nondegen_greedy_f1_mean']:.4f}")
        print(f"Non-degen construction:   {results['nondegen_construction_f1_mean']:.4f}")
        print(f"Non-degen diff:           {results['nondegen_diff']:+.4f}")

    print(f"\nFailure mode distribution:")
    for mode, pct in sorted(results.get("failure_mode_pcts", {}).items()):
        print(f"  {mode}: {pct:.1f}%")

    boot = results.get("bootstrap", {})
    if boot:
        print(f"\nBootstrap (B={boot.get('B', 10000)}):")
        print(f"  Diff: {boot.get('observed_diff', 0):+.4f}")
        ci = boot.get("ci_95", [0, 0])
        print(f"  95% CI: [{ci[0]:+.4f}, {ci[1]:+.4f}]")
        print(f"  p-value: {boot.get('p_value', 1):.4f}")


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="FewRel RE Self-Consistency Diagnostic")
    parser.add_argument("--model-path", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--data", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--samples", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--output-dir", required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--eval-only", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--n-samples", type=int, default=8)
    parser.add_argument("--temperature", type=float, default=1.0)
    parser.add_argument("--max-tokens", type=int, default=1024)
    parser.add_argument("--tensor-parallel", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--high-thresh", type=float, default=0.5)
    parser.add_argument("--medium-thresh", type=float, default=None)
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.eval_only:
        if not args.samples:
            parser.error("--samples required when --eval-only is set")
        sampled = load_sampled_results(args.samples)
    else:
        if not args.model_path or not args.data:
            parser.error("--model-path and --data required for sampling")

        instances = load_uie_jsonl(args.data)
        print(f"Loaded {len(instances)} FewRel RE instances")

        sampler = VLLMSampler(
            model_path=args.model_path,
            tensor_parallel_size=args.tensor_parallel,
            max_model_len=4096,
            gpu_memory_utilization=0.90,
        )

        sampled = run_sampling_pipeline(
            sampler=sampler,
            instances=instances,
            n_samples=args.n_samples,
            temperature=args.temperature,
            max_tokens=args.max_tokens,
            subtask="re",
            schema_hint=FEWREL_SCHEMA_HINT,
            use_grammar=True,
            use_chat_template=True,
            use_train_format=False,
            output_path=os.path.join(args.output_dir, "re_samples.jsonl"),
            realign=True,
            collect_logprobs=True,
        )
        print(f"Sampled {len(sampled)} instances x {args.n_samples} samples")

    evaluate_re_sc(
        sampled,
        output_dir=args.output_dir,
        high_thresh=args.high_thresh,
        medium_thresh=args.medium_thresh,
    )


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
